responsibility: Implements type resolution for individual Rust enum variants. It constructs TyTy::VariantDef objects for plain, tuple, struct, and explicitly discriminated variants, resolves field types for data-carrying variants, synthesizes implicit discriminant literal expressions when needed, checks explicit discriminants against isize, and records field and discriminant types in the type-checking context.
same_name_distinction: Defines the executable enum-variant resolver logic: it walks HIR enum item kinds, builds TyTy::VariantDef instances, resolves payload field types, synthesizes implicit discriminant literals, and performs explicit discriminant checking. Unlike rust-hir-type-check-enumitem.h, this file contains the actual per-variant implementation rather than just the TypeCheckEnumItem interface.
